groups.defect: In Create (line 45) and Update (line 129), the unified-storage failure path calls recordLegacyDuration, so storage failures show up in the legacy metric. These calls should use recordStorageDuration. The same copy-paste mistake appears at two call sites, and each needs its own edit.
The goroutine for the legacy DeleteCollection (line 166) records its latency with recordStorageDuration when it should use recordLegacyDuration.

answer.reasoning: There are two separate defects, and they need opposite fixes. (1) In Create (line 45) and Update (line 129), the storage-failure path wrongly calls recordLegacyDuration; the fix is to switch it to recordStorageDuration. s_00216386 and s_2d189e44 cover Create, s_de5fad1d covers Update, and s_9e1a3d59 and s_c273daf4 cover both. That makes one systemic group spanning two call sites. (2) In DeleteCollection's legacy goroutine (line 166), the code wrongly calls recordStorageDuration; the fix is to switch it to recordLegacyDuration. s_b6ded21f and s_ec6af647 even describe it as "the inverse" of the Create/Update bug. These are different concrete mistakes at different places. One find-and-replace cannot fix them, because they go in opposite directions, so posting both comments is not redundant. Judge 2 merged them only because they share the general topic of mixed-up metric helpers, so Judge 1's split is correct.
